verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail is a web-based virtual mailbox service. Headless automation is a fair question for a SaaS, and the only relevant evidence is marketing copy saying APIs can connect the mailbox to other tools and keep documents in sync. That suggests some programmatic, non-UI access, but nothing shows how to run it unattended in scripts or CI. Missing for 10: API reference documentation, a CLI or SDK, non-interactive auth (API keys or tokens) for unattended use, documented CI or automation workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
